item.title: Flickbar 0.11.0
item.description:
### What's new
- **Français et فارسی.** Flickbar now speaks French and Persian. Persian is laid out right to left, and the layout pictures still point the right way. Flickbar follows your Mac's language, or choose one in *Settings → General → Language*. - **The original icon is back.** It's rebuilt in Apple's Icon Composer, so it gets the Liquid Glass look on macOS 26 and later.
